ei.title: Practice 02 — 친숙해지고 결국 진실로 받아들여지는 거짓된 믿음과 상식
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: Life is too short to chase unicorns. It's too precious to rely on a rabbit's foot. The real solutions we seek are almost always hiding in plain sight; unfortunately, they've usually been obscured by an unbelievable amount of fake, an astounding flood of "common sense" that turns out to be nonsense. Ever hear your boss evoke the frog-in-boiling-water metaphor? ("Toss a frog into a pot of hot water and it will jump right back out. But if you place a frog in lukewarm water and slowly raise the temperature, it will boil to death.") It's a lie ― a very complete lie. Anyone ever tell you "fish stink from the head down"? Not true. Just a fish tale that actually turns out to be fishy. You may wonder how it ever became a maxim at all. Over time, myths and mistrusts get thrown around so often they eventually feel familiar and start to sound like the truth.

questions.passage: Life is too short to chase unicorns. It's too [precious / worthless] to rely on a rabbit's foot. The real solutions we seek are almost always hiding in plain sight; unfortunately, they've usually been [obscured / revealed] by an unbelievable amount of fake, an astounding flood of "common sense" that turns out to be nonsense. Ever hear your boss evoke the frog-in-boiling-water metaphor? ("Toss a frog into a pot of hot water and it will jump right back out. But if you place a frog in lukewarm water and slowly raise the temperature, it will boil to death.") It's a lie ― a very complete lie. Anyone ever tell you "fish stink from the head down"? Not true. Just a fish tale that actually turns out to be fishy. You may wonder how it ever became a maxim at all. Over time, myths and mistrusts get thrown around so often they eventually feel [familiar / strange] and start to sound like the truth.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① precious — obscured — familiar: 원문 일치. 삶은 소중하고(precious), 해결책은 가려져 있으며(obscured), 신화는 친숙하게 느껴짐(familiar)
❌ ② worthless — obscured — familiar: (A) worthless(가치 없는)는 precious의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ precious — revealed — familiar: (B) revealed(드러난)는 obscured(가려진)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ precious — obscured — strange: (C) strange(낯선)는 familiar(친숙한)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: precious(소중한) / obscured(가려진) / familiar(친숙해지는) — 지문의 핵심 흐름

det.analysis:
❌ ① trivial — evoke — mistrusts: (A) trivial(사소한)은 astounding(놀라운)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ② astounding — evoke — mistrusts: 원문 일치. 놀라운 홍수(astounding flood), 은유를 불러오다(evoke), 불신들(mistrusts)
❌ ③ astounding — dismiss — mistrusts: (B) dismiss(무시하다)는 evoke(불러오다)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ astounding — evoke — truths: (C) truths(진실들)는 mistrusts(불신들)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: astounding flood of nonsense / evoke the metaphor / myths and mistrusts — 지문의 핵심 표현

❌ ① rely — lukewarm — fiction: (C) fiction(허구)은 maxim(격언)의 반의어로 부적절

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 raise의 의미로 가장 적절한 것을 각각 고르시오.

det.korean: (A) raise the temperature = 온도를 올리다, (B) raise awareness = 인식을 높이다
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 기르다 — (B) 올리다: (A)는 기르다가 아닌 올리다
❌ ② (A) 모금하다 — (B) 기르다: (A) raise the temperature는 모금이 아닌 온도 상승
✅ ③ (A) 올리다 — (B) 높이다/키우다: 각각 온도 상승과 인식 제고의 문맥에 정확히 부합
❌ ④ (A) 올리다 — (B) 제기하다: (B) raise awareness는 의제 제기가 아닌 인식 고취
det.tip: raise = ① 올리다(raise temperature) ② 높이다(raise awareness) ③ 기르다(raise children) — 문맥별 의미 구분 필수

❌ ③ mystery: 수수께끼/미스터리. 규칙이나 진리와 무관
❌ ④ myth: 신화/미신. 진리가 아닌 허구적 이야기

questions.passage: Life is too short to chase unicorns. It's too precious to rely on a rabbit's foot. The real solutions we seek are almost always __________; unfortunately, they've usually been obscured by an unbelievable amount of fake, an astounding flood of "common sense" that turns out to be nonsense. Ever hear your boss evoke the frog-in-boiling-water metaphor? ("Toss a frog into a pot of hot water and it will jump right back out. But if you place a frog in lukewarm water and slowly raise the temperature, it will boil to death.") It's a lie ― a very complete lie. Anyone ever tell you "fish stink from the head down"? Not true. Just a fish tale that actually turns out to be fishy. You may wonder how it ever became a maxim at all. Over time, myths and mistrusts get thrown around so often they eventually feel familiar and start to sound like the truth.
